profile.headline: Software Engineer at Shiftsmart -- We're Hiring!
profile.summary:
The past 7 months I have been working as a full stack software engineer at a startup called CourtBuddy in downtown SF. I was the first onsite engineer hire which allowed me the incredible yet challenging opportunity to be responsible for executing the product team’s proposals as well as making key decisions about the stack we used. I displayed a strong work ethic, effective communication skills, and a desire to learn new technologies as I worked with the offsite team in India to transition the current PHP site into a modern Node/React stack. I built new pages and apps emphasizing a pixel perfect replica of the mocks from the design team with the use of CSS, HTML5 and React.js. Without a designated DevOps engineer, I took it upon myself to learn how to create and manage my own AWS EC2 instances, utilizing nginx and apache to successfully host React pages that communicated with php and python backend servers.

After we hired another onsite full stack engineer and three software engineer interns I demonstrated exceptional leadership and teamwork in creating and managing our on site team. I was charged with training the interns in React.js, Node.js and various other technologies. I oversaw the team while we developed two patent pending applications one of which that used machine learning to intelligently predict the classification of court cases based on user input. Due to my strong work ethic and ability to work and communicate effectively with others, accompanied with my strong technical skills and ability to learn new technologies efficiently, I am confident I would be a great contributor and team player to your company. 
---
Prior to being a software engineer, I was the personal videographer and editor for Grammy nominated artist Ryan Leslie. While touring the world together, we spent a lot of time conceptualizing an application to grow the independent artist. This lead to the creation of SuperPhone – a bidirectional mobile communications application which would later be featured in Forbes(see link below).
 
The creative process and battle of developing an idea into existence, and forging the bridge between conceptualization and a tangible, impactful product made me fall in love with programming. It is my outlet for problem-solving and creative expression. 

My technical skills and experiences include, but are not limited to JavaScript, React, Redux, Ruby, Rails, HTML, and CSS. 

Portfolio: www.anthonykumasaka.com
Projects:

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with the design and product teams to build a complete new version of the application using Node.js, React, and MySQL as the company’s first on site software engineer.
- Managed a team of three software engineering interns, training them in React/Redux and Node.js and supporting them throughout the internship while working on patent pending Case Monitor.
- Created patent pending Case Classifier application that takes the user's input and intelligently classifies the type of case through python and machine learning.
- With no designated DevOps team I constantly learned new technologies like Apache, Nginx, CloudFront and Route 53, taking ownership of the creation and maintenance of various AWS EC2 instances. 
- Used apache to allow the new React frontend to connect to the existing PHP infrastructure which enabled the creation of the courthouse, careers, areas of law and landing pages.

- Produced videos for large list of entertainers: Ryan Leslie (Grammy Nominated Artist), Kevin Fox (3 time Grammy winner), Fabolous (Grammy Nominated Artist), Kevin Hart (Comedian), Min (K-Pop), Whipped Cream Music (EDM artist), Jordan Comolli (EDM Artist), Hucci (EDM), ZakDownTown (Hip Hop Artist), and many more!
- Employed skills and knowledge concerning all aspects of production, as well as interpersonal skills to deliver quality work on time, contributing significantly to client satisfaction
- Managed cross-functional teams through effective communication and technical understanding

projects.title: Kumaflix
projects.description: KumaFlix is an inspired clone of NetFlix, utilizing videos I created during my time as the videographer and editor for grammy-nominated artist Ryan Leslie. Users of Kumaflix are able to create accounts, search and stream videos, as well as add videos to their 'My List'. Kumaflix was created with React, Redux, and Rails.
